children.name: Language Courses
children.desc: Students must complete TWO language courses at the second-year level or beyond, for a minimum of eight units total.
children.notes: Note: Language courses may not include conversational, oral communication, business, or medical language courses.

children.name: Literature Course
children.desc: Students must complete ONE literature course for at least 3 units.
children.notes: Literature courses from BOSP programs are pre-approved for the minor. Literature courses taught by Stanford faculty will be approved with the Faculty Advisor's permission.
